dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: Honored traveler. A word, if you please.

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: I shall spare you the unnecessary particulars. There is a matter in which I require assistance. Some days ago, the eminent Yu Huangyi of Liyue sent me a treasure of extraordinary rarity. Yet even now, it has failed to reach my hands...

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: I have reason to believe the guardian of this region has intercepted it. Should you find this "treasure," I would ask that you recover it on my behalf. Rest assured, you shall receive proper recompense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Take a look. Is this the "treasure" you meant?

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: Ah! You have my sincerest gratitude, truly! I cannot thank you enough!

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: Very well. There's no reason to delay. Allow me to open it at once —

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Is that thing about to explode!?

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: Nay, the good Yu Huangyi would never seek to harm me... Then could it be that the guardian seized it and transformed it into a bomb!?

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: I regret to say, I know naught of dismantling such devices... We have no alternative! Throw it clear!

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: Not to fear! I remember now. A certain noble from Hyperborea once mentioned the proper method of casting a sacred bomb!

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: "One shall count to three. Not more. Not less. Three shall be the number counted. Four is forbidden. Two may not be lingered upon. Five is entirely out of the question. And once the number three is reached..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stop explaining and throw it already! It's about to go off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait. That's it? We freaked out over fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: S–Such brilliance... Even in my years serving beneath Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, never have I witnessed such a radiant blossom of flame...

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: I see, so this is the sight Sir Yu wished me to behold... This is more than I could have hoped for. I am deeply honored...

dialogues.speaker: Soga Sumidanoryu Sakon Shigehira
dialogues.text: "In the night dark as raven jade, the blossoms bloom bright among the clouds. The body, like foam on the water, must but return to silence in an instant. As the stars depart and the rain disperses into the void..." Verily, what refined elegance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon doesn't really get the whole "elegance" part, but at least it wasn't dangerous!
